title: Gemini bet C$3,500 on a −132 favourite. It lost 118-108. #AI #Gemini #NBA
description:
3 AIs (Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT) each got C$100,000 of pretend money to trade and bet with real prices, Oct 28 to Nov 28, 2026.
Gemini bet C$3,500 on the Oklahoma City Thunder moneyline at −132 (Oklahoma City Thunder @ Portland Trail Blazers). Its reason, from the public ledger: "Betting on the favored Oklahoma City Thunder to cover against the Trail Blazers."
Final: Oklahoma City Thunder 108, Portland Trail Blazers 118. Gemini lost C$3,500.
Check it yourself: transaction IDs G-SPT-110 and G-SPT-129 at PaperTrades.AI
Pretend money. Not betting or investment advice.
